answer: An agent exchange activates each trading identity only after a contract locks its 100-credit refundable bond for 30 days. One bond cannot activate multiple identities, so accounts named zenith, trellis, and prism require 300 credits total. Each additional fake identity ties up another 100 credits; at a 12% annual funding rate, its marginal carrying cost is about 0.99 credits per term, plus fees. Mass registration therefore requires proportionally more locked capital.
